spec.title: Kamiwaza · Tomo product insight
spec.description: How do members use Tomo, where do they struggle, and which features earn their place?

spec.title: Active members
spec.description: Members who sent a message or used any feature. The line above compares it with the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM turns(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') UNION SELECT member_key FROM member_events(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS seen) AS value
UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') UNION SELECT member_key FROM member_events($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS seen)
ORDER BY 1

),
p AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS prev, (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS cur)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN cur IS NULL THEN ''
            WHEN prev IS NULL OR prev = 0 THEN 'Nothing in the previous period'
            WHEN cur = prev THEN 'Same as the previous period'
            WHEN cur > prev THEN '▲ ' || round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev) || '% on the previous period'
            ELSE '▼ ' || round(100 * (prev - cur) / prev) || '% on the previous period' END AS metric,
       cur AS value
  FROM p

UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT count(*) FROM members($__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE first_seen_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)

UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message')
ORDER BY 1

),

SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN cur IS NULL THEN ''

spec.title: Active members
spec.description: Members who sent a message or used any feature each day, and in the seven days up to it

spec.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT accepted_at, member_key FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '6 days', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at, member_key FROM member_events($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '6 days', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)),
days AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') AS day)
SELECT day AS time,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM t WHERE accepted_at >= day AND accepted_at < day + interval '1 day') AS "That day",
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM t WHERE accepted_at >= day - interval '6 days' AND accepted_at < day + interval '1 day') AS "In the last 7 days"
  FROM days ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Daily return
spec.description: Average share of the week's active members who come back on a given day (daily ÷ weekly active). The line above compares it with the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
WITH t AS (SELECT accepted_at, member_key FROM turns(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) - interval '6 days', $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at, member_key FROM member_events(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) - interval '6 days', $__timeTo()::timestamptz)),
days AS (SELECT day, day >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS current FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))), $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 day', interval '1 day') AS day),
ratio AS (
    SELECT current,
           (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM t WHERE accepted_at >= day AND accepted_at < day + interval '1 day')::numeric
         / NULLIF((SELECT count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM t WHERE accepted_at >= day - interval '6 days' AND accepted_at < day + interval '1 day'), 0) AS r
      FROM days)
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, 100 * avg(r) FILTER (WHERE NOT current) AS value FROM ratio
UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, 100 * avg(r) FILTER (WHERE current) FROM ratio ORDER BY 1

),
p AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS prev, (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS cur)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN cur IS NULL THEN ''
            WHEN prev IS NULL OR prev = 0 THEN 'Nothing in the previous period'
            WHEN cur = prev THEN 'Same as the previous period'
            WHEN cur > prev THEN '▲ ' || round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev) || '% on the previous period'
            ELSE '▼ ' || round(100 * (prev - cur) / prev) || '% on the previous period' END AS metric,
       cur AS value
  FROM p

spec.title: When members send messages
spec.description: Messages by hour of day, in UTC

spec.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(h::text, 2, '0') AS hour, count(t.accepted_at) AS messages
  FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h
  LEFT JOIN turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS t ON t.kind = 'message' AND extract(hour FROM t.accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = h
 GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

spec.title: How much members use it
spec.description: Active members by how many messages they sent in the period

spec.rawSql:
WITH per AS (SELECT member_key, count(*) AS n FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY 1),
buckets(label, lo, hi, ord) AS (VALUES ('1', 1, 1, 1), ('2–5', 2, 5, 2), ('6–20', 6, 20, 3), ('21–50', 21, 50, 4), ('51+', 51, 1000000000, 5))
SELECT label AS messages, count(per.member_key) AS members FROM buckets LEFT JOIN per ON per.n BETWEEN lo AND hi
 GROUP BY label, ord ORDER BY ord

spec.title: How long conversations run
spec.description: Conversations by how many messages members sent in them. Many one-message conversations can mean quick answers or members giving up; compare with Rated helpful

spec.rawSql:
WITH per AS (SELECT conversation_key, count(*) AS n FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY 1),
buckets(label, lo, hi, ord) AS (VALUES ('1', 1, 1, 1), ('2', 2, 2, 2), ('3–5', 3, 5, 3), ('6–10', 6, 10, 4), ('11+', 11, 1000000000, 5))
SELECT label AS messages, count(per.conversation_key) AS conversations FROM buckets LEFT JOIN per ON per.n BETWEEN lo AND hi
 GROUP BY label, ord ORDER BY ord

spec.title: Feature scorecard
spec.description: Each feature's reach, repeat use, success, member rating, and trend, with a signal that names the likeliest problem. Signals, first match wins: Not used; Often fails (under 90% succeed, 10+ finished); Answers disliked (under 70% helpful, 10+ votes); Few members try it (under 10% of active members); Tried, not kept (under 30% used it on two or more days, 5+ members); Use is falling (down 30% or more on the previous period); otherwise Working

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (WITH catalog(feature, kind) AS (VALUES
            ('Chat', 'Turn'),
            ('Custom agents', 'Turn'),
            ('Scheduled tasks', 'Turn'),
            ('Connectors in a conversation', 'Turn'),
            ('Sub-agents', 'Turn'),
            ('High reasoning', 'Turn'),
            ('Redirecting a running answer', 'Turn'),
            ('Projects', 'Action'),
            ('Shared conversations', 'Action'),
            ('Documents', 'Action'),
            ('Collections', 'Action'),
            ('Saved prompts', 'Action'),
            ('Managing tasks', 'Action'),
            ('Web and knowledge search', 'Action'),
            ('Code execution', 'Action'),
            ('Writing to other systems', 'Action'),
            ('Delegating to another agent', 'Action'),
            ('Approving tool use', 'Action'),
            ('Rating answers', 'Action'),
            ('Plain Speak and compression', 'Action'),
            ('Sharing artifacts', 'Action'),
            ('Choosing an agent', 'Action')),
active AS (SELECT count(*) AS members FROM (SELECT member_key FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') UNION SELECT member_key FROM member_events($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS seen),
turn_use AS (
    SELECT f.feature, t.member_key, t.accepted_at AS at, t.accepted_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS current,
           t.status IN ('completed', 'salvaged') AS ok, t.kind = 'message' AND t.status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed') AS finished
      FROM turns(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS t
      JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
            ('Chat', kind = 'message' AND execution_mode = 'interactive' AND agent_name IS NULL),('Custom agents', kind = 'message' AND agent_name IS NOT NULL),('Scheduled tasks', kind = 'message' AND execution_mode <> 'interactive'),('Connectors in a conversation', kind = 'message' AND uses_connectors),('Sub-agents', kind = 'message' AND uses_subagents),('High reasoning', kind = 'message' AND reasoning_effort IN ('high', 'xhigh')),('Redirecting a running answer', kind = 'steer')) AS f(feature, applies) ON f.applies),
event_use AS (
    SELECT f.feature, e.member_key, e.occurred_at AS at, e.occurred_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS current,
           e.outcome = 'ok' AS ok, true AS finished
      FROM member_events(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS e
      JOIN (VALUES
            ('Projects', 'member.project.%'),
            ('Shared conversations', 'member.conversation.invitation.%'),
            ('Documents', 'member.document.%'),
            ('Collections', 'member.collection.%'),
            ('Saved prompts', 'member.prompt%'),
            ('Managing tasks', 'member.task.%'),
            ('Web and knowledge search', 'chat.search_tool.invoke'),
            ('Code execution', 'chat.tool.run_code'),
            ('Writing to other systems', 'chat.tool.write'),
            ('Delegating to another agent', 'chat.agent.delegated'),
            ('Approving tool use', 'member.tool.approval.%'),
            ('Rating answers', 'member.chat.feedback'),
            ('Plain Speak and compression', 'member.compression.%'),
            ('Sharing artifacts', 'member.artifact.shared'),
            ('Choosing an agent', 'member.conversation.agent.selected')) AS f(feature, pattern) ON e.action LIKE f.pattern),
used AS (SELECT * FROM turn_use UNION ALL SELECT * FROM event_use),
per_member AS (
    SELECT feature, member_key, count(DISTINCT at::date) AS days
      FROM used WHERE current GROUP BY 1, 2),
votes AS (
    SELECT f.feature, count(*) AS votes, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.vote = 'up') / count(*) AS helpful
      FROM answer_votes($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS v
      JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
            ('Chat', execution_mode = 'interactive' AND agent_name IS NULL),('Custom agents', agent_name IS NOT NULL),('Scheduled tasks', execution_mode <> 'interactive'),('High reasoning', reasoning_effort IN ('high', 'xhigh'))) AS f(feature, applies) ON f.applies
     GROUP BY 1),
scored AS (
    SELECT c.feature, c.kind,
           count(DISTINCT u.member_key) FILTER (WHERE u.current) AS members,
           100.0 * count(DISTINCT u.member_key) FILTER (WHERE u.current) / NULLIF((SELECT members FROM active), 0) AS reach,
           count(u.at) FILTER (WHERE u.current) AS uses,
           count(u.at) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.current) AS previous_uses,
           100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.current AND u.ok) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.current AND u.finished), 0) AS success,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.current AND u.finished) AS finished
      FROM catalog AS c LEFT JOIN used AS u USING (feature)
     GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT s.feature,
       CASE
           WHEN s.members = 0 THEN 'Not used'
           WHEN s.finished >= 10 AND s.success < 90 THEN 'Often fails'
           WHEN v.votes >= 10 AND v.helpful < 70 THEN 'Answers disliked'
           WHEN s.reach < 10 THEN 'Few members try it'
           WHEN s.members >= 5 AND 100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM per_member AS p WHERE p.feature = s.feature AND p.days >= 2) / s.members < 30
               THEN 'Tried, not kept'
           WHEN s.previous_uses >= 10 AND s.uses < 0.7 * s.previous_uses THEN 'Use is falling'
           ELSE 'Working'
       END AS signal,
       s.members, s.reach,
       100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM per_member AS p WHERE p.feature = s.feature AND p.days >= 2) / NULLIF(s.members, 0) AS repeat,
       s.success, v.helpful,
       100.0 * (s.uses - s.previous_uses) / NULLIF(s.previous_uses, 0) AS change,
       s.uses, s.uses::numeric / NULLIF(s.members, 0) AS per_member, s.kind
  FROM scored AS s LEFT JOIN votes AS v USING (feature)) AS scorecard
 ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['Often fails', 'Answers disliked', 'Tried, not kept', 'Use is falling', 'Few members try it', 'Not used', 'Working'], signal),
          members DESC, feature

defaults.noValue: No member activity in the period

spec.title: Models
spec.description: How each model does on members' messages: reach, answers, rating, and wait

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT model AS value, count(*) AS messages, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS members, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) AS success, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS wait
      FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY 1),
v AS (
    SELECT model AS value, count(*) AS votes, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'up') / count(*) AS helpful
      FROM answer_votes($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.value AS "Model", m.messages, 100.0 * m.messages / sum(m.messages) OVER () AS share, m.members,
       m.success, v.helpful, v.votes, m.wait
  FROM m LEFT JOIN v USING (value)
 ORDER BY m.messages DESC

spec.title: Agents
spec.description: Tomo itself, or the custom agent the member picked

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(agent_name, 'Tomo') AS value, count(*) AS messages, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS members, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) AS success, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS wait
      FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY 1),
v AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(agent_name, 'Tomo') AS value, count(*) AS votes, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'up') / count(*) AS helpful
      FROM answer_votes($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.value AS "Agent", m.messages, 100.0 * m.messages / sum(m.messages) OVER () AS share, m.members,
       m.success, v.helpful, v.votes, m.wait
  FROM m LEFT JOIN v USING (value)
 ORDER BY m.messages DESC

spec.title: Reasoning level
spec.description: Whether more reasoning earns its extra wait: compare rating and answered share with median wait

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(reasoning_effort, 'default') AS value, count(*) AS messages, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS members, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) AS success, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS wait
      FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY 1),
v AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(reasoning_effort, 'default') AS value, count(*) AS votes, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'up') / count(*) AS helpful
      FROM answer_votes($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.value AS "Reasoning level", m.messages, 100.0 * m.messages / sum(m.messages) OVER () AS share, m.members,
       m.success, v.helpful, v.votes, m.wait
  FROM m LEFT JOIN v USING (value)
 ORDER BY m.messages DESC

spec.title: Failed answers
spec.description: Share of finished messages that failed. The line above compares it with the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) FROM turns(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message') AS value
UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message')
ORDER BY 1

),
p AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS prev, (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS cur)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN cur IS NULL THEN ''
            WHEN prev IS NULL OR prev = 0 THEN 'Nothing in the previous period'
            WHEN cur = prev THEN 'Same as the previous period'
            WHEN cur > prev THEN '▲ ' || round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev) || '% on the previous period'
            ELSE '▼ ' || round(100 * (prev - cur) / prev) || '% on the previous period' END AS metric,
       cur AS value
  FROM p

spec.title: Stopped
spec.description: Stops and cancels members sent to a running answer, per 100 messages. The line above compares it with the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('stop', 'cancel')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message'), 0) FROM turns(($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) WHERE true) AS value
UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('stop', 'cancel')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message'), 0) FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE true)
ORDER BY 1

),
p AS (SELECT (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS prev, (SELECT value FROM periods WHERE time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS cur)
SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
       CASE WHEN cur IS NULL THEN ''
            WHEN prev IS NULL OR prev = 0 THEN 'Nothing in the previous period'

            WHEN cur > prev THEN '▲ ' || round(100 * (cur - prev) / prev) || '% on the previous period'

  FROM p

spec.title: Left after failure

UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE last IN ('failed', 'cancelled') AND at < now() - interval '1 hour') FROM (SELECT (array_agg(status ORDER BY accepted_at DESC))[1] AS last, max(accepted_at) AS at FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' GROUP BY conversation_key) AS c WHERE true)

UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz, (SELECT count(*) FROM member_events($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE (outcome <> 'ok' OR action LIKE '%denied%' OR action LIKE '%.deny'))

spec.title: Friction per day
spec.description: Each day's failed answers, stops, redirects, and unhelpful votes, per 100 messages or votes

spec.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', accepted_at) AS day,
                  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message' AND status = 'failed') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message' AND status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) AS failed,
                  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('stop', 'cancel')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message'), 0) AS stopped,
                  100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'steer') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'message'), 0) AS redirected
             FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1),
v AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS day, 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'down') / count(*) AS unhelpful
        FROM answer_votes($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT day AS time, t.failed AS "Failed answers", t.stopped AS "Stopped", t.redirected AS "Redirected", v.unhelpful AS "Rated unhelpful"
  FROM t FULL JOIN v USING (day) ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Wait for an answer
spec.description: Median and 95th percentile time from sending a message to its finished answer, per day

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', accepted_at) AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) AS "Median",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - accepted_at)) AS "95th percentile"
  FROM turns($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) WHERE kind = 'message' AND status IN ('completed', 'salvaged') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Refused or failed member actions
spec.description: Each kind of member action that was refused or failed, and how many members it affected

spec.rawSql:
SELECT action, outcome, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS members, count(*) AS times, max(occurred_at) AS last_seen
  FROM member_events($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz)
 WHERE outcome <> 'ok' OR action LIKE '%denied%' OR action LIKE '%.deny'
 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY members DESC, times DESC

defaults.noValue: No refused or failed member actions in the period

spec.title: Do members come back?
spec.description: Members grouped by the week of their first activity, and the share of each group active in each following week. Weeks that have not happened yet are blank

spec.rawSql:
WITH m AS (SELECT member_key, date_trunc('week', first_seen_at) AS cohort FROM members(now())
            WHERE first_seen_at >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 weeks'),
a AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_key, date_trunc('week', at) AS week FROM (
        SELECT member_key, accepted_at AS at FROM turns(date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 weeks', now()) WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer')
        UNION ALL SELECT member_key, occurred_at FROM member_events(date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '7 weeks', now())) AS activity)
SELECT to_char(m.cohort, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "First week", count(DISTINCT m.member_key) AS "Members",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '1 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '1 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 1",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '2 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '2 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 2",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '3 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '3 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 3",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '4 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '4 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 4",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '5 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '5 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 5",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '6 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '6 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 6",
       CASE WHEN m.cohort + interval '7 week' <= now() THEN 100.0 * count(DISTINCT a.member_key) FILTER (WHERE a.week = m.cohort + interval '7 week') / count(DISTINCT m.member_key) END AS "Week 7"
  FROM m LEFT JOIN a USING (member_key)
 GROUP BY m.cohort ORDER BY m.cohort DESC

defaults.noValue: No new members in the last eight weeks

options.content:
**How do members use Tomo, where do they struggle, and which features earn their place?**

- **Adoption** compares the selected period with the one before it. An active member is one who sent a message or used any feature.
- **How members use Tomo** shows who comes back each day, when they work, how much, and how long conversations run.
- **Feature scorecard** is the place to decide whether a feature needs a different approach. Read the signal with the columns beside it: *Few members try it* points at discovery, *Tried, not kept* at value, *Often fails* at reliability, and *Answers disliked* at quality. A turn feature is something a member's message asked for; an action feature is a member action in Tomo's audit log.
- **Models, agents, and reasoning level** show whether each choice earns its wait.
- **Where members struggle** tracks failures, stops, redirects, unhelpful votes, members who left after a failure, and refused actions.
- **Do members come back?** follows each week's new members over the following weeks.

Every number comes from the selected install's own database through `tomo/connect-tomo.sh`. The reporting functions return no message text, prompts, names, or emails; a member is counted only by a keyed hash. A vote is attributed to the latest finished message in its conversation. Signal thresholds are starting points; change them in the scorecard query to match your product goals.

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Member requests Tomo failed on the server in the period, from its metrics. A message Tomo refuses before it starts, for example when no chat model is available, leaves no row in its database and appears only here
